home.subtitle: Cases where the system selected you as a mediator or arbitrator
home.earningsIntro: Everything you earned from mediation and arbitration since joining
home.earningsNote: The reward is fixed: 10 {currency} for each successful mediation and 10 for each arbitration decision matching the Schelling point, regardless of the dispute amount. Completing more cases well grows your earnings, not the size of each case.
home.aboutIntro: When a dispute reaches mediation or arbitration, the system draws mediators and arbitrators from the network by lottery, not nomination or volunteering. You have two days to accept or decline an invitation, and cannot see the case file before accepting.
home.mediatorText: Work with both parties toward a settlement they accept. Names are visible, no deposit is held, and you make no binding decision. Success means the parties agree.
home.arbitratorText: Decide for one of two parties and choose a penalty grade. Identities are hidden, and 10 {currency} is held as a deposit until you decide within the deadline.
home.neutrality: Fahs Mahs is separate from Etabat. Here you are a neutral participant. Disputes involving you or your organization remain in Etabat, and the system never selects you for a case in which you have an interest.
home.openInvitations: {count, plural, one {One invitation needs your response} other {# invitations need your response}}
home.invitationSummaryTwo: One mediation and one arbitration — the nearest is due in one day

invitations.subtitle: Cases the system nominated you for — respond within two days
invitations.privacy: The invitation does not show the dispute amount or case details. That is intentional: you decide based on your time and impartiality, not the reward. The file opens after you accept.
invitations.partiesHidden: Party identities are hidden until you accept
mediationExpectations: Review the case and hear both parties
Propose a settlement both parties can accept
Write a report if mediation fails
arbitrationExpectations: Review the file without party identities
Make an independent decision and penalty grade
Review the penalty grade after consensus appears
invitations.conflict: Decline if you have a relationship with either party or an interest in the dispute.
invitations.withdraw: If you discover a conflict after accepting, you may withdraw without losing your deposit.
invitations.emptyDescription: The system sends invitations by lottery when an Etab reaches mediation or arbitration.
invitations.automatic: If you do not respond in time, the invitation automatically goes to someone else. Declining does not count against you, but repeated silence reduces your chances of selection.
invitations.confirmText: 10 will be held from your balance until you decide. Missing the deadline costs the deposit, another 10 from your balance, and your panel seat.
invitations.confirmFine: If the deadline passes without a decision, you lose the deposit and another 10 from your personal balance, as well as your panel seat.

lists.appealsNote: If you were on the panel whose decision was reversed, you lose {amount} {currency}—unless your decision matched the appeal outcome, in which case your deposit and reward are paid normally.

lists.myArbitrationsNote: Party identities stay hidden even after a decision is issued. Your mediation and arbitration earnings are shown on the <link>Fahs Mahs home page</link>.

lists.myMediationsNote: Mediation fails automatically if no settlement is reached within the deadline. You can declare it failed earlier only after a party rejects an offered settlement, with another mediator agreeing.

mediation.roleText: One of three impartial mediators helping the parties reach agreement
mediation.failureText: A party must first reject an offered settlement, then a second mediator must agree to close.
mediation.failureCount: One of three mediators voted to fail
mediation.failureClosed: Mediation closed after two mediators agreed. Submit your report so the case can proceed.
mediation.settlementsText: Offer a settlement. If both parties accept, mediation succeeds and you earn 10.
mediation.proposalPlaceholder: Write a clear solution both parties can accept...
mediation.proposalTwoText: Complete the workshop within ten days, with an 80 {currency} discount for the delay.
mediation.proposalOneText: Cancel the agreement and refund the full amount.
mediation.rejected: One party accepted; the other rejected
mediation.fileText: Review the documents and responses before offering a settlement.
mediation.reportLocked: Submit the report after mediation closes.
mediation.reportWarning: The arbitration panel sees the report without mediator names.
mediation.submitted: Your proposal was offered to both parties.
mediation.unknown: This mediation workspace does not exist.
mediation.discussionIntro: All parties and three mediators can see this discussion. There are no private messages.
discussionMessages: We mainly want the remaining two sessions to happen. Participants took time off.
The trainer had a health emergency. We arranged a substitute but need ten days.
If ten days works, we need to agree on compensation for the delay.
After the first settlement was rejected, I voted for mediation to fail.
mediation.failureUnlocked: Unlocked when Workshop Studio rejected the first settlement — October 2
mediation.failureFine: If two mediators vote to fail, mediation closes immediately and moves to arbitration. Each mediator writes a report.
mediation.settlementsReward: If both parties accept, mediation closes successfully and each mediator receives 10 {currency}.
mediation.failureCountTwo: Two mediators voted to fail — mediation closed

arbitration.privacy: Party identities are hidden from you and the other arbitrators. You cannot communicate with another arbitrator before your independent decision.
arbitration.decisionText: Choose the party you believe is right after reviewing the case.
arbitration.reasonPlaceholder: Explain the facts and reasons for your decision...
arbitration.penaltyText: Choose the appropriate grade independently of who wins.
arbitration.fileText: Review all case documents before deciding.
arbitration.deadline: Missing the deadline costs your 10 {currency} deposit, another 10 from your balance, and your panel seat.
arbitration.reviewText: Four of five arbitrators chose party B. Your decision is recorded; you can now review the panel decisions and penalty grades.
arbitration.confirmed: Penalty grade confirmed. The parties will see their result in Etabat.
arbitration.anonymous: Panel members appear by number only.
arbitration.unknown: This arbitration workspace does not exist.
arbitration.reasonText: The other arbitrators will see your reasons in phase two. Parties will receive a summary.
penaltyDescriptions: Deduct only the deposit and disputed balance, with no additional penalty.
Written warning on the organization file for one year.
Suspend marketplace posting for three months and deduct 10% of balance.
Suspend membership for six months, voting in Hakima, and freeze balance.
discussionMessages: The documented health issue reduces negligence, but a written warning still fits.
The silence for 16 days caused the harm, more than the delay itself.
A one-month suspension with a warning could be a compromise.
arbitration.reviewTextOther: Your independent decision is recorded. You may review the penalty grade and discuss it with numbered panel members only.
arbitration.reviewLocked: Your decision on the dispute is locked; only the penalty grade can change.
